catalog.title: Welcome to the Northstar Supply catalog.
catalog.explanation: Stock and delivery information are checked in real time. If the stock service fails or responds too slowly, stock availability cannot be checked for now. If the delivery service fails, no delivery date can be guaranteed. When updating information fails, the system continues showing the last available results until the services work again.
catalog.connection_error: Could not refresh the catalog. No current live result is shown.
catalog.capacity_error: The shop is busy. Please try again shortly.
catalog.catalog_error: The catalog could not be refreshed. Please try again or check a product individually.
catalog.stale_notice: Showing the last successful catalog. It is not a current confirmation; individual product checks remain available.

api.reset_failed: Network faults could not be cleared: {error}

javascriptRequired: Enable JavaScript to use the interactive product catalog.
